GitHub #582's design (mitcad#2272; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-nozzle-dome-reported-test.cmake): a tube 40 to 50 about z, 50 high, with a hollow hemisphere of the same radii on it (Revolve1 F2; the dome's outer face F2:side(c17[c2+c3,c19]) runs on tangentially into the tube's F2:side(c2[c1,c3+c17]) along the circle at z = 50). A nozzle of radius 15 about z = 50 extruded from a plane 80 from the axis up to the dome's face continued (Extrude1 F5, joined), so that its side F5:side(c1) meets the dome above z = 50 and the tube below: its foot is a closed tangent chain of two edges. A flange on it, holes, a bore, Fillet1 (F17) round the flange's foot, all repeated four times about z (CircularPattern2 F18). Fillet2 (F19) rounds the three copies' feet with 1.5, picked by their dome edges.

The original nozzle's foot rounded with 1.5, picked by its dome edge: the chain runs on over its tube edge. Before, it failed: 'the geometry kernel's computation of the rounding along edge E{F2:side(c17[c2+c3,c19])|F5:side(c1)} (and 1 more edges of its chain) fails'. One valid solid at the exact size, no note.
